newsitem.title: UK: British Vita sees modest imact of pound.
newsitem.headline: British Vita sees modest imact of pound.

text.p: Chemicals company British Vita Plc said on Wednesday that it expected the current strength of sterling to have only a modest impact on its performance in 1997.

"Our view on the current strength of sterling remains unchanged, in that it will have only a modest impact on the overall performance of the group during the year," chairman Robert McGee told shareholders at its annual general meeting.
McGee said the company's efforts to improve margins were still bearing fruit as raw material costs continued to show stability.
The company was still benefitting from strong economies in the UK and U.S., he said.
